newsitem.title: USA: Haven sees increase in "in-store" costs.
newsitem.headline: Haven sees increase in "in-store" costs.

text.p: Haven Bancorp Inc said Wednesday that it was beginning to experience "substantial increases" in costs relating to the development of its in-store banking program.
However, the bank said, it was optimistic about the underlying strength of its business and about its performance prospects for the remainder of the year.

The bank announced in September of last year an in-store banking program with Pathmark Stores Inc under which it will open 44 supermarket banking branches in Pathmark stores throughout New York City, Long Island, Westchester and Rockland counties over a two year time period.
Haven Bancorp is the holding company for Columbia Federal Savings Bank.
The bank today reported first quarter earnings of $0.74 a share, up from $0.64 a year earlier.
